info.summary: Public social data from 8 platforms, paid per call.
info.description: 35 endpoints on Douyin, Xiaohongshu (RedNote), WeChat Official Accounts, Bilibili, Weibo, TikTok, X (Twitter), YouTube. One envelope, one error format, prices in US dollars per call or per item. Failed calls are never charged. Price book 1.

The outcome and charge of an earlier call, e.g. after a timeout.

bearerAuth.description: API key starting with okd_, sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: The same key with the same request within 24 hours returns the stored result with meta.replayed=true and no new charge.

type.description: What kind of post it is.

title.description: Title, where the platform has one (videos, notes, articles).

text.description: Caption, body or description as plain text; articles come as Markdown.

lang.description: Language code, as reported or detected.

published_at.description: When it was published, ISO 8601 in UTC.

metrics.description: Counts at fetch time; a count the platform hides is null.

images.description: Image URLs for image posts and notes.

hashtags.description: Hashtags or topics, without the # sign.

ext.description: Platform-specific extras. Only returned with view=full.

username.description: Handle, where the platform has one.

verified.description: Whether the platform shows a verification badge.

posts.description: Posts, videos, notes or articles published.

likes.description: Total likes received, where the platform shows it.

ext.description: Platform-specific extras. Only returned with view=full.

post_id.description: ID of the post it is under.

parent_id.description: The comment it replies to; null for top-level comments.

published_at.description: When it was posted, ISO 8601 in UTC.

ip_location.description: Region label the platform shows next to the comment, if any.

rank.description: Position on the board, 1 is the top.

heat.description: The heat score the platform shows; scales differ by platform.

url.description: Link to the topic page, if there is one.

text.description: All segments joined as plain text.

username.description: Handle, where the platform has one.

verified.description: Whether the platform shows a verification badge.

start.description: Start, in seconds from the beginning.

end.description: End, in seconds from the beginning.

text.description: What is said in this segment.

Envelope.description: Every successful response. List endpoints add data.items and page; single-object endpoints add data.item.

Page.description: Pass next_cursor back as cursor for the next page. Each page is a separate, separately charged call.

amount.description: What this call cost, in US dollars.

unavailable.description: Fields that are null and why: the platform never shows them, or they cannot be fetched yet.

replayed.description: true when an Idempotency-Key replayed a stored result at no charge.

charged.description: null: not known yet; look the call up at /v1/calls/{request_id}.

E401.description: unauthorized: The key is missing, malformed or revoked.

E400.description: invalid_params: A parameter is missing, has the wrong type, or an Idempotency-Key was reused for a different request.

E404.description: unknown_endpoint: No endpoint lives at that path. not_found: The post, account or page does not exist or is not public.

E402.description: insufficient_balance: The balance cannot cover the most this call could cost.

E429.description: rate_limited: Too many requests from this key right now.

E503.description: upstream_busy: Every data source for this endpoint is saturated.

E502.description: upstream_failed: Every data source for this endpoint failed on this request.

E504.description: timeout: No answer in time. Whether it was charged is not known yet.
